Shrimad Rajchandra Vachanamrut, Patrank.why: Typo in the YouTube title. He died in 2002. Audio catalogue entry #915 records Patrank 466 parts 11 and 12 on 15 Sep 2001, and part 12 is already published under that date.

30Mar202 Dravya Drushti Prakash17-3[chin.why: A digit dropped from the year in the source folder name, so the recording had no parseable date and was missing from the archive entirely. The two sittings either side of it — 17-4 (noon) and 17-5 (morning) — are both 30 March 2002 at the Chinchani yatra, and 17-1 and 17-2 are 29 March.

Solahkaran Bhavana, Part 32, 23 Sep 1999.why: The video title is wrong; Tejas confirmed the sitting is 20 September 1999 and is correcting the title on YouTube.
